title: 第19章 运筹帷幄3第20章 运筹帷幄4
content_zh:
随着时间推移，各个擂台的战况越发激烈。
1号擂台又上来几位勇士，但面对强大的光头大汉，均败下阵来。
2号擂台的白发老婆子周围躺下的人越来越多，可仍有自恃防毒功夫厉害的武者前来挑战。
此时，追梦在台下默默观察着一切。
他心中盘算，如果这些高手都能被招募进邹家，那邹家和邹家酒楼以及追梦正在运筹帷幄的事，安全将固若金汤。
而且随着这些人的加入，邹家必定名声大噪。
就在这时，8号擂台的暗器高手改变策略，佯装败退，趁对手不备，抛出一枚特制的回旋暗器，终于击中对方，赢得胜利。
而10号擂台的青年妇人也凭借顽强的毅力和巧妙的防守技巧，一次次挡住对手的进攻。
一个小时即将过去，每个擂台几乎都只剩下最强的守擂者。
追梦重新走上擂台，看着这些未来邹家酒楼的护卫，心中充满期待。
他高声说道：“时间已到，台上诸位便是我邹家酒楼的新护卫了！”
众人欢呼起来，一场擂台招聘就此圆满落幕。
到这，也意味着追梦的运筹帷幄第一步要有一定的武力已经达到。
现在，武功高实力强悍的护卫有了。
追梦要做的第一件事就是制作精盐，精盐制作之前追梦只敢想想，不敢实操制作。
有了这批高手，追梦信心十足。
待10人签下精神契约。
追梦开始安排起来。
通过精神契约，追梦已经知道10人的基本信息。
1号擂台守擂成功的名叫鲁达达，35岁，修为境界9级中等武师，修炼功法撼山36斧，非柳城人，江湖人称酒肉和尚。

要求只要管吃管住就行，追梦和酒肉和尚签下的是终身精神契约。
酒肉和尚从小吃的多，家里父母养不起，就送进少林寺，在少林寺他经常偷吃肉食，有一次被少林寺方丈发现，便被赶出少林寺，从此酒肉和尚流浪江湖，壮着在少林寺修炼过几年武功，又加上有点天赋，便在江湖上混出个酒肉和尚的外号。
追梦感觉酒肉和尚适合做门卫、打手、押运镖师。
2号擂台守擂成功的名叫宋茜，实际年龄45岁，修为境界7级精英武者，修炼功法毒气呼吸功，非柳城人，江湖人称银毒婆婆，银指的是宋茜的白发，毒指的是宋茜修炼的毒功，婆婆指的是宋茜因修炼毒功身体显老的外貌。
银毒婆婆要求月酬准时发放就行，还要求今后她修为境界每提升一级，就要加一倍的月酬，追梦感觉自己筹谋的事只要成功，今后钱就是数字，满口答应并签下终身契约。
追梦觉得银毒婆婆暗的适合暗杀，明的可以配合酒肉和尚一起当押运镖师。
3号擂台守擂成功的名叫西门雪，非柳城人，天赋异禀，12岁，修为境界9级中等武师后期大圆满，修炼飞雪剑法，来自3星县城的一个3级门派，修炼遇到瓶颈，需要入江湖历练，找求突破境界的方法。
西门雪女扮男装下，随意行走江湖，无意中来到柳城历练。
追梦与西门雪儿签下的是起源公约。
起源公约是一个由起源界各大主城认可，并发行的书面契约，受起源界各大主城的保护，不到万不得已，比如生命受到危险，签下起源公约的人是不会违背的。
追梦感觉自己身边还差一个武功高实力又强悍的护卫丫鬟。
西门雪的年龄和自己相仿，追梦安排西门雪充当自己的贴身护卫。
4号5号和7号擂台，最后守擂成功的人普普通通，修为境界也都刚刚到达7级精英武士。
一人来自柳城的合欢宗，55岁，合欢宗第8长老，叫柳虎。
一人来自柳城的丹鼎宗，52岁，丹鼎宗第9长老，叫宋峰。
另一人来自柳城的烈阳门，50岁，烈阳门第7长老，叫邹毅飞。
追梦感觉，这三人应该是柳城四派派来打探情况的人，追梦所做的事，又不是什么见不得人的事，追梦不怕被他们打探到，但追梦还是要防着一手，追梦准备让三人带队押送盐矿石。
6号擂台守擂成功的是一个美女，名叫柳媚娘，修为境界9级中等武师，修炼功法阴阳合欢决，17岁，柳城本地人，天赋高，从小被送进2星县城修炼，刚从2星县城学艺而归，初入江湖，暂时没有好的发展，正好赶上追梦在招聘人手，慕名而来。
追梦和柳媚娘签下的是三年的精神契约。
追梦感觉柳媚娘适合帮忙打理酒楼。

content_en:
As time goes by, the battles in each arena become more and more intense.
Several more warriors came up to Arena No. 1, but they were all defeated when faced with the powerful bald man.
More and more people were lying around the white-haired old woman in the No. 2 ring, but there were still warriors who believed in their strong anti-virus skills coming to challenge her.
At this time, Zhui Meng was silently observing everything in the audience.
He calculated in his mind that if these masters could be recruited into the Zou family, the safety of the Zou family, the Zou family restaurant, and the things Zhui Meng was planning would be impregnable.
And with the addition of these people, the Zou family will definitely become famous.
At this moment, the hidden weapon master in Arena No. 8 changed his strategy, pretended to be defeated, took advantage of his opponent's unpreparedness, and threw a specially made spinning hidden weapon, finally hitting his opponent and winning the victory.
The young woman in ring No. 10 also relied on her tenacious perseverance and clever defensive skills to block her opponent's attacks time and time again.
An hour is about to pass, and almost only the strongest defenders are left in each arena.
Chai Meng stepped onto the ring again, looking at these future guards of Zou Family Restaurant, filled with expectations.
He said loudly: "The time has come, everyone on the stage is the new guard of my Zou Family Restaurant!"
Everyone cheered, and the ring recruitment came to a successful conclusion.
At this point, it also means that the first step in strategizing to pursue dreams must be achieved with a certain amount of force.
Now, there are powerful guards with high martial arts skills.
The first thing Chasing Dreams had to do was to make refined salt. Before making refined salt, Chasing Dreams only dared to think about it but did not dare to actually make it.
With this group of experts, I am confident in pursuing my dreams.
Wait for 10 people to sign the spiritual contract.
The dream pursuit began to be arranged.
Through the spiritual contract, Zhui Meng already knows the basic information of 10 people.
The person who successfully defended the No. 1 arena was named Ludada, a 35-year-old middle-level martial artist with a level 9 cultivation level. He practiced the mountain-shaking 36 axe. He was not from Liucheng, and was known as a meat-and-wine monk in the world.
They only asked for food and shelter. Chai Meng and the fair-weather monk signed a lifelong spiritual contract.
The wine-meat monk had a lot of food since he was a child, but his parents could not afford it, so he was sent to the Shaolin Temple. In the Shaolin Temple, he often ate meat secretly. Once he was discovered by the abbot of the Shaolin Temple, he was kicked out of the Shaolin Temple. From then on, the wine-meat monk wandered around the world. He had practiced martial arts in the Shaolin Temple for several years, and had some talent, so he got the nickname "the wine-meat monk" in the world.
Chasing Dreams feels that a fair-weather monk is suitable for being a doorman, a thug, or an escort.
The person who successfully defended the ring in No. 2 is named Song Qian. Her actual age is 45 years old. She is a level 7 elite warrior who practices poison gas breathing skills. She is not from Liucheng. She is called Silver Poison Granny by people in the world. The silver refers to Song Qian’s white hair, the poison refers to the poison skills Song Qian practices, and the mother-in-law refers to Song Qian’s aging appearance due to her practicing poison skills.
Granny Yindu demanded that her monthly remuneration be paid on time. She also requested that her monthly remuneration be doubled every time her cultivation level increased. Chai Meng felt that as long as what she planned was successful, money would be just a number from now on, so she agreed and signed a lifelong contract.
Zhui Meng feels that Yindu Granny is suitable for assassination if she is dark, and she can work as an escort with the fair-weather monk if she is bright.
The person who successfully defended the No. 3 arena was named Ximen Xue. He was not from Liucheng and was extremely talented. He was 12 years old and a level 9 intermediate martial artist in the late stage of Dzogchen. He practiced Feixue Swordsmanship and came from a level 3 sect in the 3-star county. His practice encountered a bottleneck and he needed to go into the martial arts world to practice and find a way to break through the realm.
Ximen Xuenu disguised herself as a man and wandered around the world, and accidentally came to Liucheng for training.
Dream Chasing signed an Origin Agreement with Ximen Xueer.
The Origin Covenant is a written contract recognized and issued by the major cities in the Origin World. It is protected by the major cities in the Origin World. The person who signed the Origin Covenant will not violate it unless it is absolutely necessary, such as if his life is in danger.
Zhui Meng felt that he still lacked a guard maid with high martial arts skills and strength.
Ximen Xue is similar in age to me,Zhui Meng arranged for Ximen Xue to act as his personal bodyguard.
In Arena No. 4, No. 5 and No. 7, the people who successfully defended the ring in the end were ordinary people, and their cultivation realm had just reached level 7 elite warriors.
One person is from the Hehuan Sect in Liucheng. He is 55 years old and the 8th elder of the Hehuan Sect. His name is Liu Hu.
One person is from the Danding Sect in Liucheng. He is 52 years old and the ninth elder of the Danding Sect. His name is Song Feng.
The other person is from Lieyang Clan in Liucheng. He is 50 years old and the seventh elder of Lieyang Clan. His name is Zou Yifei.
Zhui Meng felt that these three people should be sent by the four factions of Liucheng to inquire about the situation. What Zhui Meng did was not a shameful thing. Zhui Meng was not afraid of being discovered by them, but Zhui Meng still had to be on guard. Zhui Meng was going to let the three of them lead a team to escort the salt ore.
The person who successfully defended the No. 6 arena was a beautiful woman named Liu Meiniang. She was a level 9 intermediate martial artist who practiced the Yin Yang He Huan Jue. She was 17 years old and a native of Liucheng. She was highly talented and was sent to a 2-star county to practice since she was a child. She had just returned from studying martial arts in a 2-star county. She entered the world for the first time and had no good development for the time being. She just happened to catch up with Dream Chaser to recruit people and came here because of her fame.
Zhuimeng and Liu Meiniang signed a three-year spiritual contract.
Chaimeng feels that Liu Meiniang is suitable to help manage the restaurant.
